---

### 1. Configuration Files

#### `/vercel/sandbox/package.json`
- **Project Type**: Next.js with ES Modules
- **Scripts**: dev, build, start
- **Dependencies**:
  - `@ai-sdk/react`: 2.0.0-beta.28
  - `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`: ^1.17.0
  - `ai`: 5.0.59
  - `next`: 15.6.0-canary.52
  - `react`: 19.1.0
  - `react-dom`: 19.1.0
  - `zod`: ^4.0.10
- **Dev Dependencies**: TypeScript, @types packages, Vitest, Vite plugins

#### `/vercel/sandbox/tsconfig.json`
- Target: ES2017
- Strict mode enabled
- Module: esnext
- JSX: react-jsx
- Path alias: `@/*` maps to root directory
- Includes Next.js plugin

#### `/vercel/sandbox/next.config.ts`
- Minimal Next.js configuration (empty config object)

#### `/vercel/sandbox/.gitignore`
- Ignores: node_modules/

---

### 2. Pages Directory - All Files

#### `/vercel/sandbox/pages/index.js` (Home Page)
- Server-side rendering with `getServerSideProps`
- Fetches 5 posts from JSONPlaceholder API
- Displays welcome message, server timestamp, user agent
- Shows recent posts list with links
- "View All Posts" button navigation to `/blog`

#### `/vercel/sandbox/pages/_app.js` (App Wrapper)
- Wraps all pages with `AppProvider` context
- Imports global styles
- Provides layout with header (navigation), main content area, and footer
- Navigation links: Home, Blog

#### `/vercel/sandbox/pages/_document.js` (HTML Document)
- Configures HTML structure
- Sets lang="en"
- Imports Inter font from Google Fonts
- Sets favicon link

#### `/vercel/sandbox/pages/_error.js` (Error Handler)
- Custom error page component
- Handles both server-side (statusCode) and client-side errors
- Shows different messages for 404 vs other errors

#### `/vercel/sandbox/pages/404.js` (Not Found Page)
- Custom 404 error page
- "Go Back Home" button navigation

#### `/vercel/sandbox/pages/blog/index.js` (Blog List)
- Static generation with `getStaticProps`
- Fetches all posts from JSONPlaceholder API
- Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) with 60-second revalidation
- Displays posts in a grid layout
- "Read More" buttons for each post

#### `/vercel/sandbox/pages/blog/[id].js` (Blog Post Detail)
- Dynamic route with `getStaticPaths` and `getStaticProps`
- Pre-generates paths for first 10 posts
- Fallback: 'blocking' for other posts
- Fetches individual post and comments data
- ISR with 300-second revalidation
- Displays post title, body, and comments section
- Back button navigation

---

### 3. API Routes - All Files

#### `/vercel/sandbox/pages/api/posts/index.js` (Posts List API)
- **GET**: Returns array of 2 sample posts
- **POST**: Creates new post (requires title and content, validates input)
- Returns 405 for unsupported methods

#### `/vercel/sandbox/pages/api/posts/[id].js` (Single Post API)
- **GET**: Returns post data with ID, title, content
- **PUT**: Updates post with provided title/content
- **DELETE**: Deletes post
- Returns 405 for unsupported methods

---

### 4. Components Directory - All Files

#### `/vercel/sandbox/components/AppProvider.js`
- Context-based theme provider using React Context
- Manages `theme` state (default: 'light')
- `useAppContext()` custom hook to access theme
- Error handling if hook used outside provider

---

### 5. Styles Directory - All Files

#### `/vercel/sandbox/styles/globals.css`
- Global CSS reset (box-sizing, margin, padding)
- Font: Inter from Google Fonts
- App container: max-width 1200px with auto margins
- Header styling: border-bottom, padding
- Navigation: links with blue color (#0070f3)
- Grid layout for posts: auto-fit with 300px minimum
- Post card styling: bordered boxes with padding and border-radius
- Comments section: similar card styling
- Error page: centered text with padding
- Button styling: blue background, white text, hover state

---

### Summary Statistics

- **Total Pages**: 8 (including special pages _app, _document, _error, 404)
- **Dynamic Routes**: 2 (/blog/[id], /api/posts/[id])
- **API Routes**: 2
- **Components**: 1
- **Configuration Files**: 4 (package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.ts, .gitignore)
- **Style Files**: 1
- **No app/ directory**: This project uses Pages Router (Next.js 12 & below style), not App Router

---

### Project Type

This is a **Next.js Pages Router Blog Application** with:
- Server-side rendering (SSR) on homepage
- Static generation with ISR on blog pages
- REST API endpoints for posts management
- Context-based state management (theme)
- TypeScript support configured
- Modern React 19 with AI SDK integration (though not actively used in current pages)

content.text:
Migration complete. The build passes with zero errors. Here's a summary of everything that was done:

## Migration Summary

### Pages Router API → App Router API replacements

| Pages Router | App Router |
|---|---|
| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` (root layout with `<html>`, `<body>`, global CSS, providers, nav) |
| `pages/index.js` with `getServerSideProps` | `app/page.tsx` — async Server Component with `headers()` and `dynamic = "force-dynamic"` |
| `pages/blog/index.js` with `getStaticProps` + `revalidate: 60` | `app/blog/page.tsx` — async Server Component with `fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 60 } })` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` with `getStaticPaths` + `getStaticProps` | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` — `generateStaticParams()` + `generateMetadata()` + `notFound()` |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` |
| `pages/_error.js` with `getInitialProps` | `app/error.tsx` — `"use client"` component with `error` + `reset` props |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` (`handler(req, res)`) | `app/api/posts/route.ts` — named `GET`/`POST` exports using `NextRequest`/`NextResponse` |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` (`handler(req, res)`) | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` — named `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE` exports with `Promise<{ id: string }>` params |
| `next/head` `<Head>` | `export const metadata` / `generateMetadata()` |
| `useRouter()` from `next/router` | `useRouter()` from `next/navigation` (in Client Components only) |
| `router.isFallback` | Removed (not needed in App Router — streaming handles this) |
| `res.status().json()` pattern | `NextResponse.json(data, { status })` |
| `req.query` | `params: Promise<{ id: string }>` (awaited) |

### New files created
- `app/layout.tsx`, `app/page.tsx`, `app/not-found.tsx`, `app/error.tsx`
- `app/blog/page.tsx`, `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`
- `app/api/posts/route.ts`, `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts`
- `components/AppProvider.tsx` (converted from `.js`, added `"use client"` + types)
- `components/NavigateButton.tsx`, `components/BackButton.tsx` (client components for `useRouter` interactions)

### Deleted
- Entire `pages/` directory
- `components/AppProvider.js` (replaced by `.tsx`)
